hook_line: H-1B EXEMPTION THRESHOLD COULD RISE TO $140,000

hook_stat.sub: Proposed new salary exemption for H-1B-dependent employers, up from $60,000

stats.label: National Average Wage Index is now nearly $70,000 — the new threshold would be twice that
Senator Jon Husted introduced the Senate version, S. 5638

diaspora_bullets: Indian nationals receive the bulk of H-1B visas each year
The proposal is not law and has no immediate effect on H-1B petitions or extensions
news_summary: Republican bills in the House and Senate would raise the salary exemption for H-1B-dependent employers from $60,000, set in 1998, to nearly $140,000 today, tied to twice the National Average Wage Index.
payoff: The proposal is not law, and the master's-degree exemption would remain.
